replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics has always been a challenge for me. I respect its importance but often find it abstract and difficult to grasp. My vocational training didn't emphasize math much, so I struggle with complex concepts.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. When faced with advanced math problems, I feel overwhelmed because my background isn't strong in this area. It reminds me of my limitations and makes me anxious.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutor for basic algebra. It helped with step-by-step explanations, but I still struggled with more complex topics. The experience was okay, not life-changing though.

replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: LLMs can provide personalized explanations, practice problems, and instant feedback. They can also make abstract concepts more relatable through real-world examples, making math less intimidating.
